character_tex: Weyl-Kac characters at $z = 0$: $\chi_\lambda(q) = \eta(q)^{-\dim G}\sum_{\beta\in Q^\vee}\prod_{\alpha>0}\frac{(\alpha,\lambda+\rho+K\beta)}{(\alpha,\rho)}\,q^{|\lambda+\rho+K\beta|^2/2K}$, $K = k + h^\vee$, long roots of length$^2$ 2 (here $\dim G = 28$, $h^\vee = 6$, $K = 7$). One block per integrable highest weight, labelled by the $SO(8)$ irrep; $h_{\mathbf{1}} = 0$, $h_{\mathbf{8_v}} = \tfrac{1}{2}$, $h_{\mathbf{8_s}} = \tfrac{1}{2}$, $h_{\mathbf{8_c}} = \tfrac{1}{2}$.
description: Diagonal modular invariant of the $SO(8)$ WZW model at level 1, $c = k\dim G/(k+h^\vee) = 4$. Characters from the Weyl-Kac formula specialised to $z=0$ (the finite Weyl sum becomes the Weyl dimension factor and the denominator becomes $\eta^{\dim G}$ by the Macdonald identity), summed exactly over the coroot lattice. The generator checks the Macdonald identity, the leading terms $\dim\lambda\, q^{h_\lambda-c/24}$ and that the weight-1 space of the vacuum module has dimension $\dim G = 28$, and compares with independent formulas: $D_4$ root-lattice theta functions $\Theta_{\lambda+Q}/\eta^4$; the characters of eight Majorana fermions, $(\theta_3^4\pm\theta_4^4)/2\eta^4$ and $\theta_2^4/2\eta^4$; $\chi_{\mathbf{1}}^2 + \chi_{\mathbf{8_v}}^2 + 2\chi_{\mathbf{8_s}}\chi_{\mathbf{8_c}} = \chi^{(E_8)_1}$.
